reply.text: I can't give you an amount for L-carnitine or any supplement. That one's for a doctor or dietitian, since they can look at what you take and why. What I can say from the training side: it's not a substitute for the work itself, and the things that move your strength most are consistent training, enough protein across the day, and sleep. If you want, we can look at how your lifts have been trending and where the gains are coming from.
